title: Weak limits of blow-ups of a cycle are cycles
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P = Euclid P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), every x ∈ U, every sequence λ_i > 0 (i ∈ ℕ) with λ_i → 0 and every C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n): if ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T) and the blow-ups η_{x,λ_i#}T = blowUp T x λ_i ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{x,λ_i}(U)) converge weakly to C (ConvergesWeakly: currentEval(blowUp T x λ_i, ω) → C(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P)), then ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C). Here BoundaryVanishes S is True in degree 0 and ∂S = 0 in degree m + 1, with (∂S)(ω) = S(dω).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ i, 0 < lams i) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → BoundaryVanishes T → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ConvergesWeakly (fun i => blowUp T x (lams i) (hlams i).ne') C → BoundaryVanishes C
